name: Stellar Community Fund — Round Deadlines → Calendar

data.label: Fetch SCF rounds page
data._sourceUrlNote: SOURCE URL — override per deployment. The Stellar Community Fund does not publish a stable public JSON endpoint for round deadlines; the current round and its Build Award submission deadline are published as HTML on the SCF site (rounds run on a ~6-week cadence; see also https://stellar.gitbook.io/scf-handbook). This default fetches the SCF homepage, which surfaces the active round + deadline.

data.label: Extract round deadlines (JSON)
data.commandTitle: Extract Stellar Community Fund round deadlines
data.promptOverride:
You are a strict data-extraction function. The input below is the raw content (HTML or text) of a Stellar Community Fund (SCF) page describing funding round timelines. Extract every concrete dated deadline you can find for SCF rounds.

Respond with NOTHING but a single JSON object, no prose, no markdown fences, exactly this shape:
{ "events": [ { "title": string, "isoDate": string, "round": string, "kind": string } ] }

Rules:
- "isoDate" MUST be a full ISO-8601 timestamp, e.g. "2026-02-01T23:59:00Z". If only a calendar date is known, use T23:59:00Z (deadlines are end-of-day).
- "round" is the round identifier as published, e.g. "SCF #41" (use the exact label on the page; if no number is shown, use "SCF").
- "kind" MUST be one of exactly: "abstract-due" (abstract / interest-form / submission-open deadline), "build-due" (build award submission / final submission deadline), or "panel" (panel review / voting / awards date).
- "title" is a short human label, e.g. "SCF #41 — Build submission due".
- Only include deadlines with a real, concrete date. If a date is relative, ambiguous, or absent, OMIT that item. If you find no dated deadlines at all, return { "events": [] }.
- Output the JSON object and nothing else.

metadata.note: Cron flow: daily fetch of the SCF rounds page → AI command extracts a { events: [...] } JSON array → loop creates one `event` entity per deadline, deduped on a synthesized round:kind key. The calendar (CRM AgendaView) renders events via properties.startDate. RELIABILITY CAVEAT: the `extract` step is a free-form IS command whose output is NOT schema-typed — the loop reads `steps.extract.output.events`, which holds only if the IS task returns that exact top-level shape. Treat extraction as best-effort v1. status:draft — user must activate before it fires.
